sql:
select da.strategy_tag, e.key, e.state, d.deployment_key, d.kind, ev.version, ep.epoch_number, (ep.ended_at is null) ep_open, d.ended_at,
 (select count(*) from paper_trades pt where pt.strategy=da.strategy_tag and pt.created_at > now() - interval '7 days') paper_7d
from experiment_deployment_arms da join experiment_deployments d on d.id=da.deployment_id
join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id=d.epoch_id join experiment_versions ev on ev.id=ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id=ev.experiment_id
where da.strategy_tag in ('mmsell9','mmsell10','Pmmsell10','Qmmsell10','Smmsell10','Zmmsell10','Xmmsell10','Ymmsell10','Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Fmmsell10','Jmmsell10','Kmmsell10','Nmmsell10','Vmmsell10')
 and d.ended_at is null
order by da.strategy_tag
